description: "Pleasure & Profit in Bible Study" by Dwight Lyman Moody is a religious guide focusing on the effective study of the Bible, written in the late 19th century. The book promotes the importance of a deep and structured engagement with Biblical scripture, advocating that consistent study leads to a more profound understanding and appreciation of faith.
